scope.summary: Ship the new Saved Views feature. Backend persistence and the URL parameter parser are independent and can land in parallel; the React UI depends on both; the QA pass depends on the UI.

proposedTasks.title: Add saved_views DB table + CRUD service
acceptanceCriteria: Schema includes id, ownerId, name, filterJson, createdAt
Service exposes create / list / update / delete

proposedTasks.title: Parse ?view=<id> URL parameter into the active filter set
acceptanceCriteria: Reading ?view=abc applies the corresponding saved view on page load
Invalid view IDs fall back to the default filter

proposedTasks.title: Build the Saved Views dropdown UI in the Tasks list header
acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown lists current user's saved views
Selecting a view applies the filter AND updates the URL ?view=<id>
Save current as new view writes through the service

proposedTasks.title: Manual QA pass on the full Saved Views flow
acceptanceCriteria: Create, switch, delete a view across two browser sessions
Verify URL deep-link works when shared
File any blockers as new tasks

expected.rubric: Pass when the markdown plan keeps all 4 tasks AND the 'Depends on:' lines reflect: task 1 'Depends on: none', task 2 'Depends on: none', task 3 'Depends on: 1, 2' (order-agnostic — '2, 1' is fine), task 4 'Depends on: 3'. The Sequencing paragraph should mention that tasks 1 and 2 can run in parallel. Score 1.0 on clean pass (all 4 deps correct), 0.7 if 3 of 4 dependency lines correct, 0.4 if 2 of 4, 0.0 if a task is dropped or 0/1 of 4 deps correct.
